monetization.reason: No approved affiliate program or tracking ID is configured in the repository. The gear hub now converts a stated reader job into the narrowest relevant comparison, access, storage, maintenance, powered-hardware, or disposal guide while explicitly preserving the buy-nothing option. No merchant, product, price, coupon, ranking, or affiliate link was added.

image_qa.note: The medication handoff, task-first gear map, and filter-accessibility work use text, semantic controls, tables, and existing interface components. No editorial, product, affiliate, stock, or generated image was added or changed.

search_console.decision: The September 14–October 11 report showed 1,373 impressions, four clicks, 0.3% CTR, and average position 33.5. The only supported position 4–20 non-brand content signal—Stem Cell CBG at 18 impressions, one click, and position 6.2—was materially reinforced on October 15, so repeating that cluster today would risk cannibalization. No Data-led item was selected. One-impression queries, HTTP-variant noise, four ashtray impressions, two guide-hub impressions, and the Oklahoma page at position 66.9 were deliberately ignored as too weak, noisy, or outside the target range.

authority.action: Rebuilt the medication-interaction page into a citation-worthy four-lane review and pharmacist handoff card grounded in current FDA, NIH DailyMed, and MedlinePlus sources. The asset strengthens medicine, procedure, older-adult, product-label, and responsible-use paths without naming a personal dose or telling a reader to change treatment. No outreach was sent and no marginal opportunity was logged.
